name: Employee health plan comparison
summary: For an owner or people lead at renewal: the broker's health plan options next to each other, with premiums split between company and employee, deductibles, out-of-pocket limits, network notes, the cost to the company and to a typical employee at low, middle and high use, and questions for the broker.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work and the employer's form of this one: the preparer's lists as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, counts by tier and never names or health details, the company's cost against this year and the budget, a stated out-of-pocket formula, every gap written as a question for the broker or a point for the owner, no plan recommended, and nothing accepted, signed, sent or changed until a person decides.

sources.contribution: Weighing several health plans for an employer group from their summaries, tier premiums, networks and enrollment by tier; each plan's type and what members pay in and out of network; a member's year at three levels of use as premium plus care costs, less any company account money; attention to each plan's drug charges and drug list; premiums compared on one footing; renewal design changes; a lower price weighed against a smaller choice of doctors and hospitals; and a closing list of what is missing and what was assumed.
